description: SVG and PNG links to a version, not the image, with size, date, hashes, engine. A published diagram's and a version link's links last until revoked, or the diagram made private or deleted (then NOT_FOUND); url is its page. Others, 7 days. A version link needs no sign-in and works from any workspace; a share link gives no title. preview adds a PNG. A page you publish: embed the png file; with no shell, call this with <ref>@<n> on open. scene or mermaid instead of id previews an unsaved diagram.

asOf.description: 2026-06-30 (end of day, UTC) or ISO 8601 with an offset

id.description: Diagram id or key, or a version link: https://zindex.ai/d/<ref>@<n>, <ref>@<n> or <ref>

knownRevision.description: Answers only { id, revision, unchanged } if it's the version to render

mermaid.description: erDiagram, flowchart or sequenceDiagram; warnings list what is dropped

name: diagram_render
title: Render a diagram
